sources.snippet: Krea 2 - an image generation model from Krea AI. API Docs • Hugging Face (RAW) • Hugging Face (TURBO) • Technical Blog This is the official repository for the open version of Krea 2, an image model trained from scratch focused on creative and stylistic exploration. The repository contains inference code and instructions to run the model.

sources.title: Krea 2 - Medium | Krea 2 Checkpoint | Civitai
sources.snippet: Krea 2 is Krea's first foundation image model, trained from scratch with a focus on how images feel rather than just what they contain. It ships in two sizes - a Large build tuned for photorealism and a Medium build tuned for illustration and stylized art - and is designed around style transfer, moodboards, and a tunable creativity dial rather than prompt length alone.
